# SingleGoalHolding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The ability of a neural system to maintain a unified behavioral goal despite receiving multiple, potentially conflicting inputs. Directly informs the design of neuromorphic controllers that need persistent, unambiguous action selection in dynamic environments.
